dominant_strengths: Clear utilitarian gallery structure with predictable left-rail navigation that helps users scan many SaaS page examples quickly
Saturated blue accent provides consistent branding anchor across notification bar, logo, CTA, and gallery card highlight
dominant_weaknesses: Blank checkbox-style icons next to every nav label feel broken or unloaded, undermining craft and trust in the interface
Heavy uniform blue overwhelms the chrome and competes with the actual screenshot thumbnails which should be the hero content
Typography is generic with weak hierarchy: brand, nav items, and card labels all use similar weights and sizes
fix_priorities: Replace empty checkbox glyphs with real category icons or remove them entirely to let labels breathe
Tone down blue saturation in header/sidebar to a neutral so screenshot thumbnails dominate visual weight
Establish stronger type hierarchy with distinct weights/sizes for brand, section labels, and card titles
Introduce consistent card framing (shadow, radius, padding) so AppSumo/FreshService/Baremetrics tiles feel like one system
rationale.norman_balance: Behavioral utility leads modestly, but visceral appeal is dampened by broken-looking icons and reflective value is low due to generic execution.
rationale.intent_fit: It functions as a SaaS-page gallery with scrollable categorized examples, but the chrome's visual noise and missing icons weaken what should be a quiet showcase.
